Add 2.2-second incomplete-prefix pause regression in the existing production harness for full duplex none/llm and half duplex.
Measure PTT release-to-first-audible reply separately from whole-reply completion in the existing real-service test.
PTT real-service test now passes the same short-reply instructions as full/half duplex through the existing pipeline constructor; no production PTT change.

intermediate_failures.phase9-pause-before: All 3 fail with one premature prefix commit and 3200 output bytes before continuation.
intermediate_failures.phase9-targeted: After rollback all 3 have zero premature commits/audio; new assertion incorrectly required a single ASR-final string to equal the SDK concatenated turn. Corrected to assert the SDK combined-turn positive EOT evidence; retained the exact input, no-premature-output checks and 1000 ms acoustic-stop budget.
intermediate_failures.phase9-core: 19 tests could not bind local gRPC ports inside the sandbox; 1 pre-existing test still asserted the removed 2-second override. Updated that contract to Session inheritance and reran with local-port permission.
intermediate_failures.phase9-ptt-latency: One PTT replay failed to observe whole-reply completion within 45 seconds. That run did not capture first-audio timing, so the cause remains unconfirmed. Subsequent unaligned replay passed with 2710.3 ms release-to-first-audible reply and 27.327 s whole completion. Retain this failure; do not infer its cause from a later passing run.

limitations: The 2.2-second pause regressions use real SDK/EOT and paced PCM with scripted speech providers and a memory sink; they do not cover every longer pause.

12 real-model cases use scripted transcripts/reply providers; 6 real-audio cases use real VAD/ASR/intent where enabled/direct LLM/TTS with generic synthetic WAVs. The 6 slow/fast real-audio variants were not rerun in this batch.
Real-service latency samples are individual observations, not a before/after controlled comparison or P95, and not RTC/device measurements.
PTT button release is the measured boundary; its input frames are fed directly to the segment recorder, not a real device microphone.
The RPC/RTC/device chain and real TTS backpressure under device playback remain unverified; pre-existing EOT/compatibility semantic xfails remain.
The non-thinking direct-LLM setting is unchanged in this batch and has not been accepted for complex-answer quality.
ptt_followup: Aligned the previously missing short-reply system instruction with the other two modes. Local PTT regression 17 passed; real PTT 1 passed. A passing bounded-reply experiment does not establish the cause of the earlier timeout or production stability.
